name: Scheme of Development Assistance to Colleges for the Construction of Buildings
benefit:
##### ***Financial Assistance***

- The scheme provides financial assistance for the construction and renovation/extension (of existing buildings) of various types of buildings (e.g., classrooms, library, laboratories, administrative block, staff quarters, hostels).
- The University Grants Commission provides financial assistance on a 100% basis within the approved ceiling.
- Colleges may seek ass
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a College. - The applicant must be included in the list of Colleges maintained by the University Grants Commission. - The applicant must be included under Sections 2(f) and 12B of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956.
